digest.component_or_area: plan review gate, tag matching, close-gate automation
propositions: The canonical tag regex pattern must widen from [operator-attested] to match both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] spellings non-capturingly across five shared consumers
The inverted-semantics consumer at txn.py ensures_ac_boxes_checked must treat unchecked [non-codebase]-tagged AC items as close-exempt, matching the behavior for [operator-attested] items
The criteria_routing.json activation trigger must recognize both tag spellings to fire the measurement-provenance route correctly
Widening the matcher must not introduce new branches that cause det_floor.py or decide_ops functions to exceed their complexity gates
ADR-0101 must be landed first to record the vocabulary definition and rationale for accepting [non-codebase] as an intentional relaxation of the fail-safe exact-token matching rule
The [operator_attested] underscore variant must NOT match, and findall() must return strings not tuples when processing mixed-spelling descriptions
